name: Schikaneder
notes:
Cinema-only (bar/DJ nights not covered, no data on site for those). Walks /kino/kinoprogramm?date=YYYY-MM-DD day by day collecting veranstaltung_ids, then fetches each /kino/veranstaltung_detail page once for its full termin (showtime) list. Programme is only actually published ~2 weeks ahead even though the date-slider widget renders 60 days of clickable tabs; scan stops early after 14 consecutive empty days. price_min taken from the site's generic 'Normalpreis' price box (8,50 EUR, stated as the default unless noted otherwise) since no per-film price exists. No genre/category field on this site, so category is always null. image is the same detail page's og:image, but the site's own markup is broken (`http://schikaneder.at:443/...` - plaintext HTTP pointed at the TLS port, connects and gets an empty reply) - rewritten to `https://schikaneder.at/...` which resolves (302 to the real jpeg), 100% fill. extra.duration_min parsed from the 'Regie, Land, Jahr
NNN min., ...' subinfo line already being fetched for description, 97% fill (one item's subinfo lacked a runtime).
